summary: Tested Email Broadcast module (Laravel) end-to-end. Backend: 25/28 checks passed. Frontend: designer + campaign flow works with all required data-testids. Personalization uses double-braces {{name}} not single-brace {name} as spec states; {{project}} is hardcoded to 'our projects' rather than lead's project.

minor.issue: Personalize function only replaces double-brace mustache tags {{name}}/{{email}}/{{phone}}/{{project}}. Spec + designer allow single-brace {name}. Single-brace tags pass through unreplaced in sent HTML (verified via laravel.log). All 5 seeded starters use double braces so they work, but user-authored templates with {name} will not personalize.
{{project}} is hardcoded to the literal string 'our projects' in EmailCampaignController::personalize(), ignoring the lead's actual project/interest_project.
Works (302 to app URL) but semantics: current impl still increments click_count even when no u provided. Consider not counting invalid click attempts.

issues: No visible 'Email Templates' / 'Email Campaigns' nav items in the sidebar screenshot (only WA Broadcasts/Templates visible). Data-testids nav-emailTemplates / nav-emailCampaigns exist in DOM and hash routes work, but user discoverability is poor. Verify these nav links are surfaced.

action_items: Extend EmailCampaignController::personalize() to accept BOTH {name} and {{name}} (and same for email/phone/project) so user-authored templates and the designer merge-tag dropdown work as documented.
Replace hardcoded '{{project}}' => 'our projects' with the lead's actual project name (e.g., $lead->interest_project ?? 'our projects').
Add sidebar nav entries for Email Templates and Email Campaigns if missing (data-testids exist but visibility unclear).
critical_code_review_comments: EmailCampaignController.php:96-104 personalize() uses only {{tag}} mustache syntax while product spec and merge-tag dropdown expose {tag} — mismatch will silently produce unpersonalized emails.
{{project}} hardcoded to 'our projects' — should pull from Lead model.
EmailMessage table does not store the rendered body_html; makes debugging bounces/complaints harder. Consider storing the personalized+tracked body (or a snapshot) for audit.
Public tracking endpoints correctly bypass Sanctum. Good.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Tpl_<ts>, TEST_Camp_<ts>, TEST_CampTEMP_<ts>, TEST_DelTpl_<ts> (deleted), plus UI_Tpl_<ts> and UI_Camp_<ts> via UI flow. No manual seeds required — Laravel DB reseed handles baseline.
